instructions: Choose the option that best describes you in each scenario. There are no right or wrong answers.

questions.scenario: When working on a team project, you typically...

options.label: A) Take charge and set the direction
options.description: You naturally step into leadership and drive results

options.label: B) Build relationships and motivate team members
options.description: You focus on team morale and collaboration

options.label: C) Provide support and ensure everyone is comfortable
options.description: You create a harmonious, stable team environment

options.label: D) Focus on quality and ensure everything is done correctly
options.description: You emphasize accuracy, standards, and thoroughness

questions.scenario: When faced with a challenging problem, you prefer to...

options.label: A) Attack it head-on and find a solution quickly
options.description: You tackle challenges directly and decisively

options.label: B) Brainstorm with others to find creative solutions
options.description: You leverage collaboration and diverse perspectives

options.label: C) Take your time to consider all angles carefully
options.description: You prefer a methodical, patient approach

options.label: D) Research thoroughly and analyze all the data
options.description: You gather facts and make systematic decisions

questions.scenario: In social or work gatherings, you usually...

options.label: A) Network strategically to advance your goals
options.description: You use social time to build useful connections

options.label: B) Enjoy meeting new people and having lively conversations
options.description: You thrive on social interaction and energy

options.label: C) Stick with a few close friends or colleagues
options.description: You prefer smaller, more comfortable groups

options.label: D) Observe and listen more than you talk
options.description: You take in information and think before speaking

questions.scenario: When things don't go according to plan, you...

options.label: B) Rally the team and maintain positive energy

options.label: C) Feel uncomfortable but try to maintain stability

options.label: D) Analyze what went wrong to prevent future issues
options.description: You investigate root causes systematically
